formats.fixed_structure: Creator in an aspirational or visually striking setting performs a leisure activity (sipping, cruising, swaying, walking, posing) while making direct eye contact with the camera, resolving with a charming smile or confident pose and optional playful caption.
formats.variable_elements: Specific setting/location (beach club, cafe, vehicle, city street, beach), type of leisure activity, outfit and styling, background audio track, and caption text.

formats.fixed_structure: Creator positions to display an outfit from multiple angles or via a reveal mechanic, culminating in a final pose that showcases the complete look.
formats.variable_elements: Featured outfit or swimsuit, location setting (beach, bathroom mirror), specific posing routine or transition method, accessories, and background audio.

formats.fixed_structure: Speaker at a podcast microphone delivers a focused thesis statement or piece of advice on a social/relationship topic, ending with an affirming or impactful message to the audience.
formats.variable_elements: Central thesis or topic (friendship, feminine energy, self-love), speaker appearance, podcast studio setup, and specific advice or quote delivered.

formats.fixed_structure: Creator poses flirtatiously or playfully for the camera with direct eye contact, interactive gestures (winking, hair flipping, pointing), and a cheeky or humorous payoff moment.
formats.variable_elements: Outfit and styling, setting and lighting, specific flirty gestures, ironic or playful caption topic, and background music/audio track.

formats.fixed_structure: Hook presents a provocative, outlandish, or curiosity-driven scenario; creator performs an activity that draws visible reactions or sets up controversy; payoff resolves with a smile or gesture plus an engagement-driving caption or question.
formats.variable_elements: Outfit or scenario provocation, public or private setting, type of reaction drawn (bystander disapproval, caption controversy), specific activity (dancing, shopping), and engagement caption or question.

formats.fixed_structure: Creator begins facing away or with a serious/aloof expression, then slowly turns toward the camera and transitions into a warm, inviting smile or laugh, creating an intimate personal introduction.
formats.variable_elements: Creator identity, outfit style, background setting, audio track, and the specific expression switch from serious/intense to warm/smiling.

formats.fixed_structure: Creator starts in a bare-faced or undone state, uses a hand-cover or transition gesture to hide the camera lens, and reveals a completed thematic look (makeup, hair, styling) with a final pose.
formats.variable_elements: Makeup theme or holiday (Valentine's Day, Halloween, NYE), specific hair accessories and makeup aesthetic, transition gesture type, and final pose.

formats.fixed_structure: Text overlay poses an identity-related question; creator reveals partial information (percentages, flags, breakdown) while withholding a final mystery element; payoff prompts viewers to guess the hidden answer in comments with a caption hint.
formats.variable_elements: Mix of flags or ethnicities shown, percentages, mystery country or flag, and the hint provided in the caption.

formats.fixed_structure: Opens with a full-body establishing pose, transitions into a montage of multiple daily activities (cafe work, skincare, walking, cooking), and closes with a cozy final scene paired with a CTA question to the audience.
formats.variable_elements: AI model design or creator appearance, featured routine activities, outfits across scenes, and final CTA question.
